raw_segments.text: After noon arrived, Mrs. Fairfax assumed her best black satin gown, her gloves and her
gold watch, for it was her part to receive the company, to conduct the ladies to their
rooms and see Adele, too, would be dressed, though I thought she had little chance of
being introduced to the party that day at least. However, to please her, I allowed Sophie
to apparel her in one of her short, full muslin frocks.
For myself, I had no need to make any change. I should not be called upon to quit my sanctum
of the schoolroom. For a sanctum, it was now become to me a very pleasant refuge in
